## 🎯 Summary
Describe the user-visible or maintainer-facing change.

## 🔍 Why is this needed?
Link related issue(s) and explain the problem.

## 🧮 Calculation and data impact
- [ ] No factor or formula change
- [ ] Factor/formula changed, methodology review linked below

For factor changes include source, date, geography, unit, boundary, gas basis, assumptions, license, and independent calculation.

## 🧪 Validation
- [ ] CI checks pass
- [ ] Manual smoke test performed
- [ ] Zero, typical, and boundary values checked where relevant
- [ ] Accessibility reviewed for UI changes
- [ ] Not tested (explain why)

Evidence, commands, and environment:

## 🔐 Privacy and security
- [ ] No secrets or personal data added
- [ ] Data collection and retention impact documented
- [ ] Dependencies and workflow permissions reviewed

## 📚 Documentation
- [ ] README and relevant docs updated
- [ ] Changelog updated
- [ ] Known issues updated where needed

## ✅ Final review
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md reviewed
- [ ] Diff checked for generated or unrelated files
